name: Yami ni Kashizuku
source:
There is one road of light in the darkness. Both girl and boy encountered there say to follow this road and turn right. Then everything will become clear.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
